features: Player fix: Cinema mode pill sits under Now Playing again and the Ambience button is back under the playback controls
Your Pattukal Official icon (note with purple dots) is now the only base icon, including the status bar and dynamic island; broken status-bar glyph fixed

Player redesigned like the new reference: Cinema pill on top, glass-framed artwork, plain round play button with orbiting ring, glass bubble previous/next, thin glass seek bar, round bottom buttons, Ambience under the controls
Luna and Kai are both back in Settings > AI Companion with a picker, and each speaks with a cute voice when read-aloud is on
Pattukal crest is now the app's base icon everywhere (the old red icon in the status bar is gone)
Luna answers faster: shorter prompts, quicker fallback and concise replies
Up-next queue redesigned in liquid glass with glass Shuffle, Repeat and Radio pills
Player buttons are now glass bubbles, with a thin glass seek bar and a play ring with orbiting lights

Luna is now a real AI companion, on by default: ask anything (science, code, study, life), chat with streaming replies, voice input, optional read-aloud and music commands like 'play something relaxing'
Companion chat is liquid glass: glass text box, bubbles and buttons; personality, time greetings and optional visible memory in Settings > AI Companion
New liquid player: a glass-tube seek bar with flowing liquid, a play button with a beat-reactive halo, and a glass up-next queue, in every theme
Every notification (downloads, song recognition, media) now uses your chosen app icon glyph
Music Cube is now clear liquid glass: each of the six faces shows a song from Quick Picks, tap the front face to play it
Default Pattukal theme: realistic rain-on-glass water drops that slide toward the side you tilt your phone, merge and leave wet trails
Liquid Sound and Beat City themes now animate the Home screen too
Player buttons redesigned as liquid glass with water-ripple presses; the play button gets a spinning light ring while music plays; colours follow the active theme
Settings redesigned: grouped glass panels with tinted icon bubbles and section titles; every option is still there
Cinema Mode: full-screen player with blurred artwork, parallax depth, synced lyrics, visualizer and minimal views (button under the player controls)
Liquid Sound theme + player background: liquid orb, chrome waves and liquid glass visuals with materials, colours, intensity and quality options
Beat City theme + player background: a neon night city that reacts to your music; swipe, pinch and tap buildings to open Favorites, Recent, Playlists, Albums, Artists or Discover
Music Cube on Home beside Quick Picks: swipe to turn, tap a face to open it; grid mode and reduced motion included
Mini player now shows live pitch bars while music is playing
Settings > Appearance > Immersive controls all of the above
Six new app icons (Cosmos crest, Note Wave, Sunset, Headphone Disc, Orbit Note, Sketchbook) alongside the official icon, plus a gallery picker that adds a home-screen icon with your own picture
New Lava flow player background: thick creamy molten lava flowing with fire-lit seams (Player menu > Player background)
Buddy voice search: tap the mic, say a song name and it plays
Drag Buddy anywhere and it stays exactly there on every screen (double-tap to let it roam again); position is remembered
Buddy blushes and sends little hearts floating up when you touch it
Buddy now lives everywhere: a small walking companion roams the app, looks toward wherever you tap, dances to your music and walks along the album art in the player
Tap Buddy for three options: Text, Suggest a song, or Remove (bring it back from Settings > AI Companion)
Chat with Buddy in a talking circle; it understands what you type, plays songs by name or from your taste, and uses your connected AI key (Settings > AI) for real conversation
Time-aware moods in India time: greetings, small talk, welcome-back and a sleepy night mode
New AMOLED Lava theme: true black with glowing molten cracks that cool and pulse, rising embers and drifting smoke
New Vinyl disc thumbnail: a spinning record with grooves, light sheen and the song art as the label (the old rotating thumbnail is still there)
Pattukal Buddy AI: meet Luna and Kai, your little music companions (Settings > AI Companion) with music commands, time-of-day greetings in India time and a sleepy night mode
AMOLED theme now has glossy 3D bubbles drifting over true black
Ambience Auto now builds a different mix for every song and evolves as the song plays
Change the player background style straight from the three-dots menu
New glowing play button with animated icon on Now Playing
Redesigned upcoming queue with glass cards and a glowing current song
New smooth screen transitions across the whole app
Every button now has a springy press effect with a soft light bloom
Animated rolling dot-wave background on the Pattukal home screen
Ambience Auto (AI) mode picks a mix for each song and time of day; ambience now starts at 30% and the button is smaller
Redesigned settings with staggered entrance animations
New smooth pull-to-refresh animation
Music recognition redesigned with a sonar orb and circular listening visualizer
AMBIENCE: layer rain, thunder, birds, river, ocean waves, wind, campfire and night crickets under your music from the Now Playing screen (plus an optional transition click)
New Nature theme and Nature player style: dark forest greens, leaf textures, falling rain and droplets sliding down the glass
Redesigned About screen with an interactive 3D tilt card
Optimized ARM64 APK: approximately 44 MB download (verified published file size)
Four additional app icons added alongside Pattukal Official
New default Vesper font
New Pattukal theme created by Akshay UI
Simple home UI refinements with the PATTUKAL heading at the top and refreshed violet-glow styling
Jet Engine smoothness improvements and reduced home-screen scrolling lag
Optimized for lower-memory devices (2 GB and 4 GB RAM); performance can vary by device
New PATTUKAL startup loader; old loading screens and startup confetti removed
Local Taste Engine: offline recommendations, skip tracking, Taste Mix, similar tracks and artists, genre signals, and cached taste snapshots
More Pattukal updates coming soon
bug_fixes: Song thumbnails now fall back to the next available size and retry once on network hiccups, so fewer blank or logo-only covers
Update screen: removed Later; one button deletes the old APK and updates. Installed update APKs are deleted automatically after install
Notification and Dynamic Island now always show the official Pattukal glyph when the official icon is selected
Notification, media card and dynamic-island glyph now matches every launcher icon you pick (all new icons included); a gallery photo always keeps the official Pattukal glyph
Notification, media-card and status-bar icon now follow the app icon you picked (photo icons use the Pattukal headphones glyph, since Android draws these as a single colour)
Phone back button now closes the Buddy menu or chat first instead of leaving the screen
Old downloaded update APKs are now cleared automatically at app start and before each new update download
Fixed home-screen scrolling lag and reduced animation overhead
Improved optimized-build compatibility and general startup stability
